title: Payi Aundi Ay, Veer Di Nagri Vich Ban Zainab Faathe Shaamey
body:
Karo Istaqbal Musafiran Da
Uth Kar Abbas Salaamey
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehle Lut Karbal Di Pesh Hoi
Lag Deir Gayi Darbar De Vich (x2)
Mere Saamne Mangda Shimar Reya
Tere Qatal Da Veer Inaamey
<<DIVIDER>>
Kufe Te Shaam De Vich Baba
Mein Qadam Qadam Te Qatal Hoya (x2)
Jis Chaader Lut Layi Zainab Di
Kiti Os De Naal Kalaamey
<<DIVIDER>>
Vicho Qabar Toun Uth Ke Das Baba
Mere Kaafilay Vich Teri Bhain Kerdi (x2)
Ban Ummal Musaib Aagayi Eh
Gaya Badal Zainab Da Naamey
<<DIVIDER>>
Kar Eho Jeya Matam Gayi Zainab
Khule Hath Ja Shaam Di Qaidan De (x2)
Tanveer Eh Matam Nai Rukna
Jadh Tak Rehna Islamey
